scholarships.name: RaiseMe Scholarships
scholarships.description: RaiseMe connects your achievements to school-specific micro-scholarships. All you have to do is follow New York Tech, create a profile listing your grades and activities, and preview what your financial aid package could look like once you’re accepted. Create Your Profile

scholarships.name: NYITCOM Student Receives American Heart Association Scholarship
scholarships.description: A student researcher from the College of Osteopathic Medicine (NYITCOM) has secured the prestigious Student Scholarship in Cardiovascular Disease from the American Heart Association. College of Osteopathic Medicine 08.04.26
